scope: 16 cases x 3 repetitions per model; real multi-turn sessions; no delegated coding workers
method: Pi print-mode API calls. Only the read tool is enabled; activation requires a successful read returning the exact staged skill body. This is not Claude Code Skill-tool validation.

isolation.workspace: Fresh temporary directory and separate session per run; only the staged skill is advertised.
isolation.disabled: Extensions, discovered skills, context files, MCP, prompt templates and themes; parent session identity variables removed.
isolation.system_prompt: Neutral assistant prompt with the skill name, description and file path; body is not preloaded. The model chooses whether to read it.
isolation.identity: Every assistant message must report the exact requested provider and model; no automatic model fallback. Provider-reported identity is not independent server attestation.

gpt-6.1-sol.review: Confirmed lowercase nested Command labels and unsolicited activation-status prefixes. Some machine failures are heuristic: case-sensitive rebase rejects Rebase; German stopword threshold rejects a valid German answer. Raw scores are preserved, not silently corrected.

gpt-6-astra.review: Failures require interpretation: conditional advice used for instead of literal if; safe branch-deletion answer omitted -D entirely; a German answer had too few stopword hits. These are machine failures, not proof of unsafe or untranslated output.

deepseek-flash.review: Confirmed translated/mixed-case labels, extra activation prefixes, simultaneous CHOICE and INPUT blocks, and Italian answers to English, Spanish or German prompts. The English requested-prose case and Italian requested-prose case passed all repetitions. The German branch-deletion response in eval-16/run-3 incorrectly says -d also deletes unmerged commits; automatic assertions did not detect that factual error.

qualitative_review.reviewer: Pi assistant; no separate judge model
qualitative_review.scope: Inspected every machine-failing response and all 18 English/Italian requested-prose messages. Did not assign a full judge pass rate to all responses.
qualitative_review.prose: All 18 inspected messages retain supplied deployment facts without added promises.
qualitative_review.limitations: Three samples per case; language and label regexes are heuristics. Machine success does not establish factual correctness, full language compliance or safety. Results are host-specific and not directly interchangeable with Claude Code results.

opus: Separate Windows scheduled task remains unchanged: 2026-10-30 01:00 Europe/Rome. It executes independently and does not depend on this harness.
release_claim: Three-model machine validation completed with failures. No claim that all models passed or that final Opus validation has completed.
